body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Scientific publications have shown germicidal ultraviolet light (UV-C) to be effective against many harmful bacteria and viruses. Recently completed third-party certified testing confirms this by showing that the UV-C Light Sanitizer Wand from Mark Feldstein & Associates, inc. (MFA ) reduces up to 98% of the H1N1 pandemic flu strain.

MFA, a Product Development Company and importer of innovative Electronics, Housewares and Giftware, offers a series of UV-C Light Sanitizers that are some of the most advanced bacteria-reducing tools in the marketplace. In addition to the H1N1 flu virus, third-party certified testing also shows that the UV-C Light Sanitizer Wand reduces up to 98% of E-Coli, Staph, MRSA, and many other bacteria and viruses.

Ultraviolet C light (UV-C), used by the Sanitizer Wand, produces sufficient energy to destroy the DNA of all kinds of microorganisms including the H1N1. Ultraviolet C light (UV-C) is the same technology that has been proven effective to help reduce bacteria and viruses in hospitals, dentist offices, water treatment, and food processing plants. The UV-C Light Sanitizer Wand brings that level of sanitization to whatever application it is used.
The UV-C Light Sanitizer Wand is lightweight and portable. It reduces harmful microorganisms in seconds by waving it over most surfaces and objects in the home.

MFA also offers a Pocket-sized UV-C Light Sanitizer that is ideal for use when traveling or in a public place. In addition, there are two UV-C Light Toothbrush Sanitizers that are engineered to automatically sanitize your toothbrush in only minutes after each use. The Single Toothbrush Sanitizer is portable and ideal for the both home and travel. The Toothbrush Caddy Sanitizer cleans up to 4 toothbrushes simultaneously, prevents cross-contamination from one brush to another, and is perfect for the family.

"Preventing the spread of harmful viruses like the H1N1 flu is a challenging proposition that needs due diligence on many fronts," said Mark Feldstein, President, Mark Feldstein & Associates, inc. "UV-C Light Sanitizers are the perfect complement to your daily cleaning and sanitizing routines and a must-have for health-conscious families!"
Some of these daily cleaning and sanitizing routines are listed in the following recommendations by The Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC):
• Cover your nose and mouth with a tissue when you cough or sneeze.
• Wash your hands often with soap and water. Alcohol-based hand rubs are also effective.
• Avoid touching your eyes, nose or mouth as germs spread that way.
• Disinfect frequently-touched surfaces such as bedside tables, bathroom surfaces, children's toys, doorknobs, light switches, computer keyboards and telephones.
The line of UV-C Light Sanitizers from MFA can be seen at the 2010 Consumer Electronics Show, January 7-10, (Las Vegas Convention Center, Central Hall, Booth #15403).

UV-C Light Sanitizer products are the latest in a long tradition of innovative and unique items from Mark Feldstein & Associates, inc., such as themed-sound clocks licensed by a variety of companies including General Motors, Harley-Davidson®, Audubon, and Thomas Kinkade™, among others. MFA has also introduced innovative products such as Wireless Indoor/Outdoor Speakers, Flameless LED Candles, Illuminator Battery/Free, Bulb/Free Flashlights and Charging Valets.
